notes.title: (Reminder Update) The Full Revamped Update! (v4.1.0)
notes.notes:
This is just a reminder that we release a full revamp update to the game for those who hasn't played the update yet!

It's time for a full revamp!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42618439/1a2b8cfd68df3480ca71d7d4375e8539fe98b10d.png

We left it off at the 2 year anniversary update originally. Now it's time for a full makeover, including the store page, which we totally didn't forget about, until now, haha!

Changes

 Changed the music background on almost all levels, so it's more original then... well... yeah!
 Changed the skybox on all levels, including the Halloween levels
 Added decorations in all of the Halloween levels


Notes: If you are playing this game in VR and want to change some graphics settings, use it with caution as increasing the quality of the game may stutter some VR headsets, and reduce performance.

notes.title: v4.0.3 Update!
notes.notes:
An update to this game has been released!

 Fixed a bug where progress wasn't resetting upon entering level 1, or level 1 hard mode for a no damage run.

Notes: If you are playing this game in VR and want to change some graphics settings, use it with caution as increasing the quality of the game may stutter some VR headsets, and reduce performance.

notes.title: v4.0.2 Update!
notes.notes:
An update to this game has been released!

 Fixed an issue where the player isn't able to die by the crushers on level 7, and level 7 hard mode.
 Fixed an exploit on level 7, and level 7 hard mode where you were able to avoid getting killed by an unescapable crusher.

Notes: If you are playing this game in VR and want to change some graphics settings, use it with caution as increasing the quality of the game may stutter some VR headsets, and reduce performance.

notes.title: v4.0.1 Update!
notes.notes:
An update to this game has been released!

 Fixed an issue where the "New Game" sequence doesn't activate upon playing the game for the first time.
 Fixed an issue for VR where it was just straight up unplayable.
 Fixed an issue in level 1 where enemies weren't able to catch you at certain spots of the map.
 Made "The Cubic Log" actually grabbable in desktop mode.
 We had to remove the ability to duel wield because it would cause a lot of issues, including making VR mode completely unplayable.
 Fixed an issue where the level 6 secret level takes you back to the beginning of the game (again).
 Fixed an issue in level 7 for when the enemies get killed from the crushers counts as you killing them, thus making pacifist run unplayable.
 Removed old text from level 8 that represented the old version of the rapid fire weapon.
 Removed a random collision in level 9.
 Fixed an issue in hard mode where it keeps sending you to normal mode upon finishing level 1.
 Fixed an issue where upon booting up the game again. It sometimes won't load your save progress.
 Changed the pause menu in VR mode to now have a settings button.
 Added a settings menu in VR mode.
 Changed the post processing effect in some levels to be up-to-date with what the game has.
 Re-added the audio settings menu.
 Changed the level 6 hard mode weapon from a rapid fire weapon to a regular weapon (we're not gonna make it easier for you :3)
 Added new music into the game.
 Changed the credits text to include a new person who helped made said music into the game.
 Added new adjustment settings in the graphics menu.

Notes: If you are playing this game in VR and want to change some graphics settings, use it with caution as increasing the quality of the game may stutter some VR headsets, and reduce performance.

notes.title: 2 YEAR ANNIVERSARY UPDATE!
notes.notes:
We launch this game 2 years ago. As a celebration, we went back and updated the game to be more on what we have for The Multiverse Trilogy. This update wouldn't have been possible without the help of GhosStudios, We also want to wish a very happy birthday to a couple of friends close to Phoenix Limit Studios, including the CEO of GhosStudios!

Patch Notes

WARNING: This game has been upgraded to a newer version of Unreal Engine 5, and there might be a few bugs that we have missed when porting this game to a new engine version. If that's the case, let us know by starting a discussion here on the Steam page, or on our Discord server.

Changes

 Added proper Nanite, and Lumen (becomes disabled by default in VR mode.)
 Changed a couple of levels.
 Improved lighting in some levels.
 Changed how the game launches between VR mode and Desktop mode.
 Added a player health bar in VR mode.
 Changed the Rapid Fire weapon to now be a permanent weapon pickup.
 Improved boss fights by adding dynamic changes to the environment, and/or changing one of the abilities.

Notes

 We had to temporarily remove the audio settings menu as we are still improving it.
 In the upcoming days, the Steam page screenshots will be updated so they are up-to-date on the current state of the game build.
 Expect some stealth hotfix updates to the game as we polish out some rough edges that came along in this patch.
